title: trun from Text track is being associated with wrong TrackBundle when playing video with both a Video track and a Text track
body:
When attempting to play a fragmented .mp4 video that contains a Video track and a Text track (see mp4info screen grab below), the trun from the Text track is being added to the Video track causing an `"Invalid NAL length" ParserException` to be thrown. I believe this is caused by the fix added for [this issue](https://github.com/google/ExoPlayer/issues/4083) in `FragmentedMp4Extractor.java` on line 921. 

You can reproduce this by playing the video I emailed to dev.exoplayer@gmail.com in the sample exoplayer app. That video plays in all other video players I have tried including Chrome, Firefox, iOS, and more.
